name: Plagued Hatchlings
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Argent Dawn recently learned that the Scourge are creating their own plagued dragonflight!  We must stop them -- if the Scourge gain a force of dragons they'll sweep across Azeroth unchecked!

Their necromancers are breeding plagued dragons at the Scholomance, in the middle of Darrowmere Lake.

Go to the Scholomance and kill as many hatchlings as you can... before they get any bigger!
narrative.objectives: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done, adventurer!  It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons.

...At least, I hope it will!
narrative.requestItemsText: Get to the Scholomance, adventurer.  Take out those plagued hatchlings before they grow!
